files.deploy/local-stack/Dockerfile:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
FROM node:26-alpine3.23

ARG SEAWEED_VERSION=4.47
ARG SEAWEED_AMD64_SHA256
ARG SEAWEED_ARM64_SHA256
ARG TARGETARCH

RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates curl docker-cli haproxy iproute2 iptables openssl tar wireguard-tools \
 && case "$TARGETARCH" in \
      amd64) archive=linux_amd64.tar.gz; digest="$SEAWEED_AMD64_SHA256" ;; \
      arm64) archive=linux_arm64.tar.gz; digest="$SEAWEED_ARM64_SHA256" ;; \
      *) echo "Unsupported local-stack architecture: $TARGETARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac \
 && curl --fail --location --silent --show-error "https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/releases/download/${SEAWEED_VERSION}/${archive}" --output /tmp/weed.tgz \
 && echo "$digest  /tmp/weed.tgz" | sha256sum -c - \
 && tar -xzf /tmp/weed.tgz -C /usr/local/bin weed \
 && rm /tmp/weed.tgz \
 && npm install --global pnpm@9.15.0

WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npm_token,required=true \
    --mount=type=cache,id=waitron-cloud-pnpm,target=/root/.local/share/pnpm/store \
    token="$(cat /run/secrets/npm_token)" \
 && printf '//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=%s\n' "$token" > /root/.npmrc \
 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile \
 && pnpm portal:build \
 && pnpm store prune \
 && rm /root/.npmrc

ENV NODE_ENV=development
CMD ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "account"]
files.deploy/local-stack/local.env:
# Loopback-only host ports for the reproducible local stack.
LOCAL_STACK_ACCOUNT_PORT=3000
LOCAL_STACK_POSTGRES_PORT=55432
LOCAL_STACK_MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT=1125
LOCAL_STACK_MAILPIT_UI_PORT=8125
LOCAL_STACK_STORAGE_PORT=8333
LOCAL_STACK_GATEWAY_TLS_PORT=8443
LOCAL_STACK_GATEWAY_WIREGUARD_PORT=51820
LOCAL_STACK_IMAGE_TAG=dev
files..env.example:
# Local email capture; separate ports let Waitron's Mailpit run alongside Cloud.
# The complete Compose deployment reads deploy/local-stack/local.env instead of this file.
# Export NODE_AUTH_TOKEN only in your shell when building it; do not save that token here.
# See docs/local-deployment.md.
MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT=1125
MAILPIT_UI_PORT=8125
# The optional portal and account API share this origin.
CLOUD_PORTAL_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000
# The durable worker also needs DATABASE_URL and a persistent key ring.
# Generate a local key once; see docs/email-delivery-implementation.md.
# CLOUD_EMAIL_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=local-v1
# CLOUD_EMAIL_KEYS={"local-v1":"<64 hexadecimal characters>"}

# Production delivery requires an explicitly selected relay and HTTPS portal origin.
# See docs/production-email-implementation.md. Supply secrets through your deployment.
# NODE_ENV=production
# CLOUD_MAIL_TRANSPORT=smtp
# CLOUD_SMTP_HOST=<approved relay hostname>
# CLOUD_SMTP_PORT=465
# CLOUD_SMTP_USER=<application user>
# CLOUD_SMTP_PASSWORD=<application credential>
# CLOUD_MAIL_FROM=accounts@your-verified-domain.example
# CLOUD_PORTAL_ORIGIN=https://your-cloud-portal.example

# Account API: migrate DATABASE_URL first and reuse the email key ring above.
# CLOUD_HTTP_RATE_KEY=<a separate persistent 64-hex-character key>
# Required in production: absolute path to a locally supplied lowercase SHA-256 corpus.
# CLOUD_COMPROMISED_PASSWORD_CORPUS=/run/secrets/compromised-passwords.sha256
# CLOUD_HTTP_HOST=127.0.0.1
# CLOUD_HTTP_PORT=3000
# Only list proxy socket peers configured to replace X-Forwarded-For with one IP.
# CLOUD_HTTP_TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS=

# Optional portal: pnpm portal:build, then pnpm account:serve.
# CLOUD_PORTAL_ASSETS_DIR=apps/portal/dist

# Optional Ed25519 PKCS8 DER/base64url issuer key for installation lifecycle APIs.
# Keep stable across instances and restarts; see packages/account-http/README.md.
# CLOUD_INSTALLATION_ISSUER_KEY=

# Pairing-code verification keys, separate from the database and all other keys.
# CLOUD_PAIRING_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=pairing-2026-09
# CLOUD_PAIRING_KEYS={"pairing-2026-09":"<64 hexadecimal characters>"}

# Independent backup-recovery request code key map; see docs/recovery-code-keys.md.
# CLOUD_RECOVERY_ACTIVE_KEY_ID=recovery-2026-09
# CLOUD_RECOVERY_KEYS={"recovery-2026-09":"<64 hexadecimal characters>"}

# Optional venue alert timings in whole seconds (0 disables each, maximum 604800).
CLOUD_MONITOR_QUIET_SECONDS=0
CLOUD_MONITOR_REMINDER_SECONDS=0
files.compose.yaml:
name: waitron-cloud

x-cloud: &cloud
  image: waitron-cloud-local-stack:${LOCAL_STACK_IMAGE_TAG:-dev}
  build:
    context: .
    dockerfile: deploy/local-stack/Dockerfile
    args:
      SEAWEED_VERSION: "4.47"
      SEAWEED_AMD64_SHA256: 31fb804858885f9e7f18b6d3b1da09e824baac3e6a55b5a62c3c4c77e6ed6d7d
      SEAWEED_ARM64_SHA256: ba5c9def9ff98f78becdf309a50a9f906922f6383a7c4c772d01ede3cc012e16
    secrets:
      - npm_token
  init: true
  read_only: true
  tmpfs:
    - /tmp:mode=0700
  volumes:
    - local-stack-config:/run/local-stack:ro

services:
  bootstrap:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/bootstrap.mjs"]
    restart: "no"
    volumes:
      - local-stack-config:/run/local-stack

  postgres:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: cloud
      POSTGRES_DB: cloud
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/local-stack/postgres-password
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U cloud -d cloud"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 30
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${LOCAL_STACK_POSTGRES_PORT:-55432}:5432"
    stop_grace_period: 10s
    volumes:
      - local-stack-config:/run/local-stack:ro
      - local-stack-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql

  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit:v1.31.1
    environment:
      MP_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE: 1
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/mailpit", "readyz"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 30
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${LOCAL_STACK_MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT:-${MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT:-1125}}:1025"
      - "127.0.0.1:${LOCAL_STACK_MAILPIT_UI_PORT:-${MAILPIT_UI_PORT:-8125}}:8025"
    stop_grace_period: 5s

  migrate:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "migrate"]
    restart: "no"
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  storage:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["weed", "mini", "-dir=/data", "-ip=storage", "-ip.bind=0.0.0.0", "-master.port=9333", "-master.port.grpc=19333", "-volume.port=8080", "-volume.port.grpc=18080", "-filer.port=8888", "-filer.port.grpc=18888", "-s3.port=8333", "-s3.cert.file=/run/local-stack/storage-cert.pem", "-s3.key.file=/run/local-stack/storage-key.pem", "-s3.config=/run/local-stack/storage-iam.json", "-admin.ui=false", "-webdav=false", "-s3.port.iceberg=0", "-s3.port.lance=0"]
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:8333 -CAfile /run/local-stack/storage-ca.pem -verify_return_error </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 60
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${LOCAL_STACK_STORAGE_PORT:-8333}:8333"
    stop_grace_period: 10s
    volumes:
      - local-stack-config:/run/local-stack:ro
      - local-stack-storage:/data

  account:
    <<: *cloud
    environment:
      CLOUD_STAFF_CERTIFICATES: ${CLOUD_STAFF_CERTIFICATES:-0}
      CLOUD_FACTOR_POLICY: ${CLOUD_FACTOR_POLICY:-}
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "account"]
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "--silent", "http://localhost:3000/api/health/ready"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 30
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${LOCAL_STACK_ACCOUNT_PORT:-3000}:3000"
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 12s

  email-worker:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "email"]
    depends_on:
      mailpit:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    network_mode: service:mailpit
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 10s

  monitor-worker:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "monitor"]
    environment:
      CLOUD_MONITOR_QUIET_SECONDS: ${CLOUD_MONITOR_QUIET_SECONDS:-0}
      CLOUD_MONITOR_REMINDER_SECONDS: ${CLOUD_MONITOR_REMINDER_SECONDS:-0}
    depends_on:
      mailpit:
        condition: service_healthy
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    network_mode: service:mailpit
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 10s

  usage-reconciler:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "usage"]
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      CLOUD_USAGE_INTERVAL_MS: ${CLOUD_USAGE_INTERVAL_MS:-60000}
      CLOUD_USAGE_BATCH_SIZE: ${CLOUD_USAGE_BATCH_SIZE:-100}
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 15s

  operations-collector:
    <<: *cloud
    profiles: [operations]
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/operations-collector.mjs"]
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      account:
        condition: service_started
    environment:
      CLOUD_OPERATIONS_INTERVAL_MS: ${CLOUD_OPERATIONS_INTERVAL_MS:-60000}
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${LOCAL_STACK_OPERATIONS_PORT:-9091}:9091"
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 5s

  remote-probe:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "probe"]
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 10s

  gateway-manifest:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "manifest"]
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 5s
    volumes:
      - local-stack-config:/run/local-stack

  gateway:
    <<: *cloud
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "gateway"]
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      gateway-manifest:
        condition: service_started
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "const s=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/state/status.json'));process.exit(s.ready&&s.routes===0?0:1)"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 30
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${LOCAL_STACK_GATEWAY_TLS_PORT:-8443}:443"
      - "127.0.0.1:${LOCAL_STACK_GATEWAY_WIREGUARD_PORT:-51820}:51820/udp"
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 10s
    volumes:
      - local-stack-config:/run/local-stack:ro
      - local-stack-config:/input:ro
      - local-stack-gateway:/state

  backup-worker:
    <<: *cloud
    profiles: [backups]
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "backup"]
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      storage:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 15s
    volumes:
      - local-stack-config:/run/local-stack:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    environment:
      CLOUD_VERIFIER_IMAGE: ${CLOUD_VERIFIER_IMAGE:-waitron-backup-verifier:local}
      CLOUD_VERIFIER_OWNER: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-waitron-cloud}-backup
      CLOUD_VERIFIER_MEMORY_MIB: ${CLOUD_VERIFIER_MEMORY_MIB:-1024}
      CLOUD_VERIFIER_SCRATCH_MIB: ${CLOUD_VERIFIER_SCRATCH_MIB:-256}

  remote-reconciler:
    <<: *cloud
    profiles: [remote-reconciliation]
    command: ["node", "deploy/local-stack/runtime.mjs", "reconcile"]
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 10s
    volumes:
      - local-stack-config:/run/local-stack:ro
      - ${LOCAL_STACK_RECONCILER_DIR:-./.local-stack/reconciler}:/run/reconciler:ro

volumes:
  local-stack-config:
  local-stack-postgres:
  local-stack-storage:
  local-stack-gateway:

secrets:
  npm_token:
    environment: NODE_AUTH_TOKEN
